features.ordered-polymorphism: Numeric, type and proof binders in source order; semantic stages retained.
features.partial-numerics: Partial numeric type functions and their constraint obligations.
features.class-constraints: Resolved value-type class constraints and structural primitive lifting.
features.finite-words: Finite bit sequences, wrapping arithmetic, shifts and bitwise operations.
features.finite-sequences: Finite sequences and exact indexing, split, join and update conventions.
features.lazy-recursion: Simultaneous least fixed points and demanded observations.
features.bounded-folds: Source folds compiled with a supported-shape certificate.
features.full-comprehensions: Sequential and parallel generators and local declarations.
features.lazy-aggregates: Heterogeneous tuples and records with lazy fields and updates.
features.numeric-guards: Ordered numeric guards, with the selected branch assumptions.
features.pure-foreign-fallback: Retain and interpret a foreign declaration’s pure body.
features.modular-arithmetic: Modular integers and explicit modulus/primality hypotheses.
features.polynomial-arithmetic: Binary polynomial arithmetic and field calculations.
features.productive-streams: Demand-driven infinite sequences and finite observations.
features.general-recursion: Recursive calls beyond a certified bounded fold or prefix recurrence.
features.module-provenance: Module parameters, imports, instantiations and declaration identities.

profiles.compression256: Every 8-word UInt32 state and 16-word block; byte boundary: state.size = 8 and base + 64 ≤ bytes.size. Base need not be aligned.
profiles.finite-bits: All finite bit lengths admitted by the source constraints. A byte implementation additionally requires byte alignment and its size limits.
profiles.xof: Finite input and requested output lengths admitted by the source; track bit/byte units and zero-length output explicitly.
profiles.aes: All 128-bit blocks, keys of length 128/192/256, pure foreign fallbacks.
profiles.crc: Finite input; update/concatenation theorem restricted to byte-aligned inputs for reflected profiles.
profiles.composition: Source-admitted finite parameters and supplied hash/PRF functions; no unproved equivalence assumptions hidden in a concrete instance.
profiles.p256: P-256 only; validate nonzero denominators, scalar/range conditions, point validity and the behavior of invalid encodings.
profiles.keccak-state: Every finite lane width; all 25 lanes with explicit x/y and bit-order conventions.

trusted_steps: Cryptol 3.6.0 frontend, type checking and erased constraints
typed AST exporter and constructor decoder
monomorphic structural reification, comprehension translation and lambda lifting

assumptions: Arbitrary finite lane width, including zero; total indexed input
trusted_steps: Manual transcription of lane order; no imported-AST correspondence
Manual transcription of expandedData and remainder equations; no pmod bitvector correspondence
